verses.1: And they heard the troubles of the Jews and of Benjamin, for the children of the land were building a house for the LORD, the God of Israel.
verses.2: And they went to Zerubavel and to the leaders of the fathers. They said to them, “We have prepared offerings for you. Since you are our gods, we offer these offerings to you. We offer them as sacrifices from the time of Asar Haddon, king of Assyria, who raised us up.”
verses.3: And Zerubbabel and Jeshurun, and all the leaders of the fathers, said to Israel, “Do not go with them. Let us build the house for our God together. For we will build it together, as God, the Lord of Israel, has commanded us, by King Cyrus.”
verses.4: And the people of that land became afraid of the people of Judah, and they were terrified.
verses.5: And they are commanded to follow their advice every day, from the time of King Persia’s reign until the time of King Darius.
verses.6: And in the reign of Ahaziah, at the beginning of his reign, a curse was written upon the rulers of Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.7: And in the days of Artaxerxes, it was written in Aramaic. The rest of his writings were also written in Aramaic. They were translated from Aramaic into other languages.
verses.8: May mercy be upon those who have a good taste and whose names are written in books. May they be blessed, just as the king of Jerusalem was blessed.
verses.9: Adayin has mercy upon those who are righteous. Shimshai is a book of laws. The rest of their deeds are also related to these laws. They are all part of this world.
verses.10: And the rest of those who are still alive will be destroyed by Asnafar Rabbah. They will also be destroyed by Yakira. They will be destroyed in Kirya, in Shamrayin. And the rest of those who live in Nahara and Keneet will also be destroyed.
verses.11: Dena Parshgen said, “They sent me to Artachashshata, the king of your servants. They sent me over the river, and I became like a tree.”
verses.12: Let them know to the king of the Jews that they have been driven out from your kingdom. Let them be destroyed in Jerusalem. May their children and descendants be destroyed as well.
verses.13: Thus, let it be known to the king that these are the things that will be built and created. But they were not given to him, and his kings became weak.
verses.14: Just as every one who receives salt is also dipped in salt, so too, the king’s anger cannot be known through his actions. We must not rely on his words or actions to understand him.
verses.15: In the day when your fathers forget about you, and you are forgotten in the midst of those who are forgotten. Then you will know what has happened to your kings and rulers, and what harm has been done to them. They will serve you in ignorance, from the time of eternity onward. That is the day of your destruction.
verses.16: We know that the king has these plans in mind. His plans will be fulfilled, and his soldiers will be able to receive their share of the spoils. But it’s not yet time for you to go.
verses.17: Pithgamá sent a message from the king, with kindness and respect. She also sent books and other gifts. All these things can be understood in Shamarayn. And all the rest of the things related to Nahrásham…
verses.18: May they be punished for sending us here, so that we may be destroyed from before our eyes.
verses.19: And from me, I set the taste and the bitterness in their hearts. They forget those days from ancient times when kings were overthrown and rebelled against their rule.
verses.20: And the kings surrounded Jerusalem. They ruled over all the areas along the rivers and streams. Then he went away to Hona.
verses.21: Just as they tasted bitter, so too will those who are worthless. I will go away, and your flesh will not be preserved until my taste buds can enjoy its flavor again.
verses.22: And they warn that those who serve Dena will suffer great harm, and it will cause great damage to the kings.
verses.23: Eadien min di Faršeggan nishtvanu di Artachashasht Malkha Kari Kedam-Rahum, and Shimshai Sapra. And their destruction was announced in Jerusalem, regarding the Jews. And in that time, they were destroyed in Edra’a and Chayil.
verses.24: In the time when he served in the household of the gods in Jerusalem, and during the reign of Darius, king of Persia.
